name: Secret Detector
author: RequestReaver
description: Detects secrets, API keys, tokens and private keys exposed in requests and responses, and raises a finding for each one.
features: Scans every request and response passing through the proxy
Detects AWS, Google, Slack, GitHub and Stripe keys
Flags private key blocks and OAuth client secrets
Raises a finding per secret with redacted evidence

notes: Overview screenshot, feature list and general category.
Detects AWS, Google, Slack, GitHub and Stripe keys plus private key blocks.
